name: Centrum Medyczne ENEL-MED S.A.
summary: Centrum Medyczne ENEL-MED S.A., a prominent healthcare provider established in 1993, operates from its Warsaw, Poland base, offering an extensive array of medical services nationwide. These provisions encompass specialized consultations, dentistry, orthopedics, infertility treatments, physical rehabilitation, psychological support, and comprehensive diagnostic capabilities. Additionally, they provide vaccinations, emergency care, and surgical interventions to their patients.
